::: {#hero-heading}

Welcome to my site! I am a Ph.D. student in Economics at [HKU Business School]([link](https://www.hkubs.hku.hk/)). I obtained my Bachelor's Degree in Economics from [School of Economics, Peking University]([link](https://econ.pku.edu.cn/)).

My research interests include labor economics, development economics, and Chinese economy, with special focus on migration and education. 

Contact: wzgang@connect.hku.hk

:::
